# HomeWaterMath

Free, source-backed calculators and guides for home water: water softeners, private wells and water filters. Every formula and source is shown.

## Calculators
- [Water softener size calculator](https://homewatermath.com/water-softener-size-calculator/): Grains you need from your household and hardness, at your real salt setting.
- [Water softener settings calculator](https://homewatermath.com/water-softener-settings/): What to enter on your softener: hardness, capacity, reserve and day override.
- [Water softener cost calculator](https://homewatermath.com/water-softener-cost/): Unit, install, salt and service, with a 10-year total and a quote check.
- [Water softener salt calculator](https://homewatermath.com/water-softener-salt-calculator/): Pounds per month, bags per year and yearly cost for your softener.
- [Water softener installation cost calculator](https://homewatermath.com/water-softener-installation-cost/): Itemized install labor: loop, drain, outlet, removal and permit.
- [Salt vs salt-free water softener cost calculator](https://homewatermath.com/water-softener-vs-salt-free-cost/): Salt vs salt-free over 10 years for your home, with what each one does.
- [Water hardness converter](https://homewatermath.com/water-hardness-converter/): gpg, ppm, mg/L, mmol/L and German or French degrees in one step.
- [Well pressure tank size calculator](https://homewatermath.com/well-pressure-tank-size-calculator/): Tank size and pre-charge from your pump's gpm, horsepower and switch setting.
- [Well pump replacement cost calculator](https://homewatermath.com/well-pump-replacement-cost/): Pump, pipe, wire, tank and call-out by type and depth, plus repair-or-replace.
- [Reverse osmosis system cost calculator](https://homewatermath.com/reverse-osmosis-system-cost/): Under-sink, tankless or countertop, with filters and water sent to drain.
- [Whole house water filter cost calculator](https://homewatermath.com/whole-house-water-filter-cost/): Cartridge, carbon tank or well system, with media changes for your use.

## Guides
- [Water softener not working? Find the cause](https://homewatermath.com/water-softener-not-working/): Five free checks, repair costs, and repair-or-replace.
- [Iron filter for well water: which type and size](https://homewatermath.com/iron-filter-for-well-water/): Which filter and size from your iron, manganese, sulfur and flow.
- [How to test water hardness at home](https://homewatermath.com/how-to-test-water-hardness/): Strips, drop-count kits, a lab or your utility report.
- [Well water testing: what to test and what it costs](https://homewatermath.com/well-water-test-kit/): What to test, when, EPA limits, and what it costs.
- [How long do water softeners last?](https://homewatermath.com/how-long-do-water-softeners-last/): Life by part, what wears out first, warranties.
- [Water softener cleaner: dose and how often](https://homewatermath.com/water-softener-cleaner/): Dose and how often, with label doses and a dose calculator.
- [TDS meter chart: what your reading means](https://homewatermath.com/tds-meter-chart/): What your reading means, taste bands and an RO check.
- [Hard water vs soft water: what actually changes](https://homewatermath.com/hard-water-vs-soft-water/): Scale, soap, skin, health and sodium, with the test results.
- [Can you drink softened water?](https://homewatermath.com/can-you-drink-softened-water/): How much sodium softening adds, and when to keep a plain tap.

## Category pages
- [Water softener calculators](https://homewatermath.com/water-softeners/): Size, cost, salt, install, salt vs salt-free, and hardness for US homes.
- [Well water calculators](https://homewatermath.com/well-water/): Pressure tank sizing, well pump replacement cost, hardness and softener sizing.
- [Water filter calculators](https://homewatermath.com/water-filters/): Reverse osmosis and whole house filter cost, filters and media over 10 years.
